title: Technology Sector Update for 05/01/2018: I, USM, COMM, SABR, AMZN
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.01%
AAPL: +0.8%
IBM: +0.03%
CSCO: -0.4%
GOOG: +0.3%
Technology shares were higher in pre-market trading on Tuesday.
Expected movers:
- Intelsat ( I ): Q1 loss misses Street view, revenue beats
- United States Cellular ( USM ): reports mixed earnings; beats Street on EPS, falls short on revenue
- Commscope ( COMM ): slips pre-bell as it lowers 2018 core earnings guidance, but exceeds Q1 expectations
Other news:
- Sabre ( SABR ): partners with Amazon ( AMZN ) to provide travel information services
